segments.say: Stop typing. Three AI dictation tools with free plans.
One. Granola Voice Typing, free on every Granola plan. On a Mac, hold F N and talk.
Two. Wispr Flow. Free on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android, with a weekly word cap.
Three. Superwhisper. Its free plan dictates with on-device models.
Check each plan's limits. Save this, and follow for a free tool every Friday.
Job interview this week? Let AI grill you first.
Don't ask it for tips. Make it run the interview, one question at a time.
Interview me for the role I want. Ask one question at a time. After each answer, give one strength, one fix, and a stronger version. Stop after five questions.
segments.text: Interview me for a [job title] role. Ask one question at a time. After each answer: one strength, one fix, a stronger version. Stop after 5 questions.

segments.say: Answer it like the real thing. The feedback after each answer is the practice.
segments.text: Let's start. Question 1: Tell me about a time you missed a deadline. What did you do next?

segments.say: Save this for your next interview, and follow for one AI prompt a day.
Meeting notes that stay on your Mac. Then the follow-up email.
Not tested by us. This is based on official info.
Step one. Google AI Edge Foresight, an experimental Mac app. Google says it uses your mic and system audio to fill in your shorthand notes, fully on device, even offline.
Step two. Paste the notes into ChatGPT. Its free plan drafts emails. Ask for an action item table, then a short follow-up email.
Step three. Check names and dates yourself, and tell people before you record.
Comment if you want a real hands-on test.
Three real AI fails, all on the public record.
Not tested by us. Based on official info and news reports.
One. Google's AI search answers once suggested glue on pizza. Google's own blog blamed joke forum posts.
Two. Air Canada's chatbot made up a refund rule. A tribunal made the airline pay, CBS News reported.
Three. Lawyers filed six fake cases that ChatGPT made up. A judge fined them, Reuters reported.
Check AI answers against a real source. Comment if you want a real hands-on test.
